item.flyimpact.fly_barrel_upgrade.toolti: Install in a Sophisticated Backpack upgrade slot to open a portable fly barrel tab.
tooltip.flyimpact.hybridization_guide.re: Patchouli is required to read this guidebook
patchouli.flyimpact.landing: Welcome to the Flyimpact hybridization guide.$(br2)This book is a tree, not a list: open a fly chapter to see its parents and what it can breed into. Links jump between related chapters.$(br2)Some recipes only appear when Create, AE2, Mekanism, or Touhou Little Maid is installed.
patchouli.flyimpact.subtitle: Flyimpact Field Guide
patchouli.flyimpact.category.intro.desc: How breeding works, and how to read this book.
patchouli.flyimpact.category.dye.desc: Color varieties and the starter lines.
patchouli.flyimpact.category.ore.desc: Metal and gem flies. Mod-gated recipes are hidden until those mods load.
patchouli.flyimpact.category.extra.desc: Extra flies added by this addon.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.overview.page0: Each fly has its own chapter. Open it to see how to obtain that fly, then follow $(thing)Related Chapters$() to walk the hybridization tree.$(br2)Click highlighted names to jump.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.overview.page1: The breeding chest combines two flies. Same variety purifies; different varieties cross. Progress goes through synapsis, segregation, then assortment.$(br2)Mutation chance is shown in each recipe chapter.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.overview.page2: You receive this guidebook the first time you join a world. If you lose it, craft a book with a normal fly and maggots.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.breeding.page0: Put two flies in a breeding chest. If they match a loaded recipe, the chest can produce the child fly.$(br2)The progress tooltip shows whether you are crossing or purifying.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.breeding.page1: Recipes in this book come from PoopSky and Flyimpact. Conditional recipes vanish from the tree when their required mod is missing.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.breeding.page2: The Simple Breeding Chest works like the breeding chest, but extra slots hold poop-type blocks and maggot blocks.$(br2)Each poop-type block shortens the cycle by 0.5 seconds (minimum 1 second). Each maggot block adds one extra fly and consumes one extra feces.
tooltip.flyimpact.transfer_upgrade: Exports products into the inventory below at %sx hopper speed
tooltip.flyimpact.fluid_upgrade: Adds a 32-bucket tank. Fluid items produced by flies fill the tank, and pipes can insert or extract
tooltip.flyimpact.energy_upgrade: Adds a 100,000 FE buffer. Working flies generate energy, which is pushed to adjacent machines
Poop-type blocks: each item shortens the cycle by 0.5 seconds (min 1 second)
Maggot blocks: each item adds +1 fly and consumes +1 feces
jei.flyimpact.simple_breeding_chest.info: A compact breeding chest. Extra slots accept poop-type blocks and maggot blocks, using the same bonuses as surrounding a breeding chest.
jei.flyimpact.breeding_chest.missing_fli: Missing the required fly types in your inventory
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.blaze: Feed a fly a blaze rod, or breed a Dragon Fruit Fly with an Orange Fly. Emits blaze flame and smoke, glows like a blaze, and is fireproof
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.wheat: Feed a normal fly wheat, or breed a Green Fly with a Lime Fly
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.pumpkin: Feed a fly a pumpkin, or breed a Yellow Fly with an Orange Fly. The Fly Barrel has a 25%% chance to output a carved pumpkin
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.fairy: Touhou Little Maid integration. Breed a Red Fly with a Pink Fly. The Fly Barrel outputs Power Points
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.altnoir: Name a fly Altnoir with a name tag, or let a Normal Fly take part in a breeding chest 99 times
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.steve: Name a fly steve_ with a name tag
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.chili: Feed a fly a Dragon Breath Chili, or breed a Dragon Fruit Fly with a Blaze Fly
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.coal: Feed a fly a block of coal, or breed a Diamond Fly with a Gray Fly. The Fly Barrel outputs coal. Burns as furnace fuel for 8 items
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.dirt: Breed a Brown Fly with a Rotten Flesh Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs dirt
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.grass_block: Breed a Dirt Fly with a Green Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs grass blocks
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.rich_soil: Farmer's Delight integration. Breed an Altnoir Fly with a Dirt Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs Rich Soil
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.egg: Breed a Wheat Fly with a Rotten Flesh Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs eggs
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.charcoal: Breed a Coal Fly with a Black Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs charcoal
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.ender_eye: Breed an Ender Fly with a Blaze Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs Eyes of Ender
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.ghast_tear: Breed an Eye of Ender Fly with a Netherite Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs ghast tears
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.end_crystal: Breed a Ghast Tear Fly with an Eye of Ender Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs End Crystal Shards
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.soul_soil: Breed a Dirt Fly with a Black Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs soul soil
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.nether_star: Breed a Soul Soil Fly with a Ghast Tear Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs Nether Star Crumbs
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.saltpeter: Feed a fly saltpeter. The Fly Barrel outputs saltpeter
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.snowball: Breed a Saltpeter Fly with a Blue Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs snowballs
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.poolime: Breed a Blue Fly with an Altnoir Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs Poolime Blocks
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.gravel: Feed a fly gravel. The Fly Barrel outputs gravel
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.golden_poop: Breed an Altnoir Fly with a Gold Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs Golden Poop
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.urea: Feed a fly urea. The Fly Barrel outputs urea
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.roundworm: Feed a fly a roundworm. The Fly Barrel outputs roundworms
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.cobblestone: Breed any two of Diorite, Andesite, and Granite Flies. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs cobblestone
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.carrot: Feed a fly a carrot. The Fly Barrel outputs carrots
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.potato: Feed a fly a potato. The Fly Barrel outputs potatoes
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.beetroot: Feed a fly a beetroot. The Fly Barrel outputs beetroot
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.kelp: Feed a fly kelp. The Fly Barrel outputs kelp
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.cod: Feed a fly a cod. The Fly Barrel outputs raw cod
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.salmon: Feed a fly a salmon. The Fly Barrel outputs raw salmon
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.sand: Breed a Roundworm Fly with a Charcoal Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs sand
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.soul_sand: Breed a Sand Fly with a Black Fly. Mutation chance: 35%. The Fly Barrel outputs soul sand
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.nether_wart: Feed a fly nether wart, or breed a Beetroot Fly with a Soul Sand Fly. Mutation chance: 20%. The Fly Barrel outputs nether wart
jei.flyimpact.cooked_fly.info: Smelt a fly in a furnace, smoker, or campfire to eat it
